entities.summary: William Edward Cousins was an American Catholic prelate who served as archbishop of Milwaukee in Wisconsin from 1958 to 1977. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Chicago in Illinois (1948–1952) and as bishop of Peoria in Illinois (1952–1958).
